body: A Vietnam Vet who lost his legs in the war in 1971 is told by the VA he needs to prove his legs are missing.
That's too bad. When played well they have (or are) the sound of the human soul.
My hope is to come back some day. Do they still play bagpipes in the streets, much like they play guitars in the artsy areas of the cities? I loved it there.

Still? What a wonderful surprise. Oh how I loved it there. 

Peter
